host_local_selection.question: Claude or Codex is running in a terminal on your Linux box. A hook fires, or the agent sends a notice or sets its pane title. Where does that call go?

options.A: Host-local (Lead recommends): agent calls from inside a session stay on the Host; every other CLI command still goes through the Gateway.
options.B: Through a Mac Gateway: Linux to Mac to Linux; fails or must queue when no Mac is awake.
